question: Who among the following is referred to as ‘Prince of Bhangra’, due to his Bhangra music?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sukhbir Singh**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Sukhbir Singh **is an **Indian singer**.
 
• He is **often referred **to as the **"Prince of Bhangra".**
 
• His **Bhangra music **varied from **fusion to pure Punjabi **at **times**.
 
• He was **born on 9 November 1969 in Jalandhar**.
 
• His **famous albums **are **Hindi Medium, Good Newz, Dhoom D:1 And D:2, Switchh (Original Motion Picture Soundtrack), and Dhoom2.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Diljit Dosanjh **is an **Indian singer**, **actor**, **film producer**, and **television presenter **who works **in Punjabi and Hindi cinema**.
 
• **Arijit Singh **is an **Indian singer **and **music composer**. He **sings predominantly **in his **native Bengali **and **Hindi **but has also performed in various other Indian languages. He is the **recipient **of a **National Award and six Filmfare Awards**.
 
• **Shantanu Mukherjee**, known as **Shaan**, is an **Indian playback singer**, **actor**, and **television presenter **active in **Hindi, Bengali, Marathi**, **Assamese**, **Kannada**, and **Telugu**, **Tamil**, **Gujarati**, **Marathi**, **Malayalam**, and **Urdu language films **and **a television host**.
